support_locator: LED/display system architecture and cross-department interface synthesis
paraphrase_notes: Supports treating a large LED display as a multi-layer system rather than panels alone.
applicability_notes: Layer ownership and architecture vary by product and production.
required_qualifier: Systems understanding does not grant structural, power, rigging or service authority.
authority_owner: video lead/system owners and relevant qualified departments

support_locator: playback/media-server, processing and LED display role architecture
paraphrase_notes: Supports distinguishing source/content rendering from display processing/mapping as functional layers.
applicability_notes: Actual products and role splits vary substantially.
required_qualifier: No media-server or processor configuration procedure is implied.

support_locator: LED power interface and production-power boundary synthesis
paraphrase_notes: Supports that LED power planning is a system interface requiring actual product demand information and qualified production-power review rather than average consumption alone.
applicability_notes: Exact demand, distribution and electrical rules depend on equipment/system/jurisdiction.
required_qualifier: No circuit sizing, load calculation or energized work is taught.

support_locator: LED system advance, logistics and integration synthesis
paraphrase_notes: Supports advancing the display as a complete system with cross-department interfaces rather than as panel count alone.
applicability_notes: Advance fields and ownership vary by tour, venue, vendor and project.
required_qualifier: Do not treat the advance as structural/power/weather approval.

support_locator: LED data-path, processor and troubleshooting synthesis
paraphrase_notes: Supports recognizing downstream-group symptoms as potentially related to a shared data/signal path while avoiding a product-specific diagnosis procedure.
applicability_notes: Exact topology and failure modes are product/system specific.
required_qualifier: Pattern suggests a domain to investigate; it does not prove a fault or authorize service.
